show.description: Life Swapping is a magical, emotional drama about rivalry, identity, and second chances. Gautam, a shy gamer constantly overshadowed by his arrogant brother Manit, stumbles upon a mysterious globe that grants his wish—to be like Manit. But when their souls are swapped for ten days, both brothers are forced to live each other’s lives, facing love, humiliation, and truth in ways they never imagined.
